articles.title: Why BMI Is Not the Best Measure of Health
articles.summary: BMI, or body mass index, has long been a part of health evaluations. A calculation that takes into account a person’s weight and height, BMI is supposed to reflect how much excess fat a person might be carrying and give doctors a sense of a patient's risk for obesity-related health conditions. For years, however, doctors have found that BMI isn’t the best measure of obesity-related health, since it can’t distinguish between fat and muscle weight. articles.title: Trump Gutted USAID. Congo Pays the Price in an Ebola Epidemic
articles.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is reeling from an outbreak of Ebola that is estimated to have killed nearly 5,400 people. The World Health Organization (WHO) has described it as “the largest Ebola outbreak ever reported” in the country. The outbreak was first detected in Mongbwalu , a gold-mining town of around 130,000 people in Ituri province in northeastern Congo, after the WHO was alerted on May 5 about an unusual cluster of illness and deaths.
